answer: Each identity works an orchard plot on a terrace, locking 60 credits refunded if clean. A terrace board caps plots at 10 per terrace each epoch; a prism ledger lists registrations by band, for auditor recompute. A filled terrace pushes the next identity higher, paying sunk toll up 10 per terrace climbed: the kth fake pays 20+10*(ceil(k/10)-1). One thousand fakes sink 515,000 in tolls and lock 60,000 credits. A terrace-stacking ring on terrace 1 fails: the board voids the 11th registration, burns its bond, and a reused receipt fails prism recompute. An honest identity pays 20, locks 60 once.
